title: Invertibility of the normalized integral Tate quotient morphism
statement: For a Noetherian scheme T and a prime ell invertible on T, and n,d natural numbers, any morphism from realization T ell n of finiteSheaf T ell n d to quotientLine T ell n d satisfying GeneratorCompatible is an isomorphism.

source.place: Step 2: Invertibility of the normalized integral Tate quotient morphism

proof.text: Apply the pointwise local isomorphism criterion to the underlying presheaf map. The sheaf-valued forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, and the top sieve is a covering sieve, so the local isomorphisms supplied by the lower node give IsIso f.

proof_origin.place: Step 2: local rank-one isomorphism followed by sheaf descent
